question: How does the one supreme power come to appear as a pair?
premises: This supreme power is in reality one alone.
Through connection with the differentiation of the power-holder she attains the state of being a pair.
inference: The single supreme power appears as a dyad through its relation to the differentiated power-holder.
plain_english: In reality this supreme power is one alone and draws forth time. Yet through its connection with the differentiation of the power-holder, it takes on the form of a pair.
